answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a superconducting coil whose quench pulse signature is physically unclonable, forcing attackers to acquire scarce hardware rather than spin up keys. At the nadir of trust, validators cross-check spallation-derived entropy against each orchard of registered coils, rejecting any cluster whose neutron. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
